description: This file defines a fake implementation of the ImapHandlerInterface, used primarily for testing purposes within the SuiteCRM project. It provides stub methods that delegate to a fake data manager, aiding in unit tests that require imap handling without interacting with real IMAP servers.

classes.name: ImapHandlerFake
classes.description: A mock implementation of ImapHandlerInterface for testing that forwards method calls to a fake data handler.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the fake data handler.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Retrieves the current IMAP connection resource.

methods.name: getErrors
methods.description: Returns errors encountered during IMAP operations.

methods.name: isAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the IMAP service is available.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens a connection to a mailbox.

methods.name: ping
methods.description: Checks if the connection is alive.

methods.name: getHeaderInfo
methods.description: Retrieves header info for a message.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends a message to a mailbox.

methods.name: isValidStream
methods.description: Checks if a stream is valid.

methods.name: getMessageList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of messages based on filters and sorting options.
